trigger: Thread or PID exhaustion, or bad_alloc, during a gateway-routed fan-out: forward_gateway_pending drains the queue then spawns one detached std::thread per command with no try/catch, so a spawn that throws destroys every not-yet-spawned drained command with no terminal response.
summary: AgentRegistry::send_to returns true at gw_pending_.push_back (queued, not delivered), so progress.sent counts all N queued commands; if a spawn then throws, the throw arm stores agents_targeted=N and says 'at least N agent(s) were sent', responses can never reach N, and the reaper (which only takes agents_targeted=0 rows) never closes the row. Regression versus pass 2, where targeted=0 let the reaper close it after about 30 to 45 minutes. Derived HIGH via I3 base and I5(c) (wedges a state machine); native MEDIUM.
classification_rationale: Derived HIGH governs the gate. Wedge fix from the pass-2 round (ec2ce4371) made the queued-for-gateway count authoritative.
caused_by: ec2ce4371 (pass-2 D1 wedge fix: SendProgress counts accepted sends)
